candidates.change_summary: Remove the reentrancy guard by deleting the nonReentrant_ modifier invocation so SetMinSum can be called without the locked_ check, allowing different observable behavior of MinSum when reentrancy or repeated calls occur.
Invert the initialization check to only allow SetMinSum when intitalized is true, changing when MinSum can be set.
Make the nonReentrant_ modifier permit reentrancy by removing the require check and not setting locked_, so functions protected by it (like SetMinSum) behave differently under reentrant calls.
Removed the revert guard so SetMinSum can be called even after initialization (deleting the check that reverts when intitalized is true).
Changed the condition to revert when not initialized, so SetMinSum only works after Initialized() has been called (inverted the original guard).
Removed the reentrancy guard logic so nonReentrant_ no longer prevents reentrant calls (deleted require and locked_ assignments).
Removed the guard that prevents SetLogFile from running after initialization by deleting the revert check, so SetLogFile can change LogFile even when intitalized is true.

Added an explicit requirement that intitalized is false (using require instead of the original if+revert), which changes the revert behavior message path but keeps semantic check; this still affects whether SetLogFile can update LogFile observable after call.
Removed the reentrancy protection by deleting the locking logic in the modifier, allowing SetLogFile to be reentered and possibly produce different observable state after the call.
Replace body to set intitalized = false instead of true (so Initialized() clears the flag).
Replace body to toggle intitalized rather than setting it true (flip its value).
Replace body to set intitalized = true only when it's currently false, otherwise revert (adds conditional revert preventing re-setting).
Replace nonReentrant_ modifier to omit resetting locked_ = false after function execution (locks contract permanently after first use).
Replace nonReentrant_ modifier to set locked_ = false before the function body instead of after (allow reentrancy by clearing lock early).
